summary: Master subscription retention strategies. Learn CLV optimization, churn reduction, and SaaS revenue growth in our expert-led 5-day course. Enroll today.
lede: Subscription retention training helps professionals managing recurring revenue analyze churn and plan retention actions. It is designed for subscription product managers, customer success leads, and revenue operations professionals who need to turn customer and usage data into practical workflows. The course covers cohort and churn analysis, customer health scoring, subscription pricing models, customer journey mapping, and dunning and expansion strategies.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-to-advanced program is tailored for professionals who already manage recurring revenue streams and seek to professionalize their retention workflows.
audience: Growth Marketing Specialists focused on upsell
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of business finance and at least 2 years of experience in a recurring revenue environment (SaaS, media, or service-based subscriptions). Familiarity with basic spreadsheet analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) is required for modeling exercises.
